deviations.resolution: Template tier = verbatim EXCEPT universal identity-scrub
deviations.detail: IDENTITY split by hardness — HARD scrub-blocking literals (owner full-names, infra hostnames, DB names, vendors, client names) tokenize UNIVERSALLY (all tiers); SOFT de-identification literals (bare project name / owner-handle) are .md-prose-only, same gating as STRUCTURAL. Executables receive hard-scrub only and keep functional domain vocab + project-prefixed workflow names; Plan 02 config-sources them. owner:/maintained_by: frontmatter tokenized to {{OWNER}} universally. Loupe-specific danger keyword dropped from DANGER_RE so the tokenized regex stays valid ERE.
